content:
sylvia: Quick FYI: doing a small CRM hygiene push tonight 10pm PDT (60m). Tasks: dedupe low-activity trials, add idempotency_key to playbook webhook payloads, and run a 2% canary for healthscore_v2. Will keep healthscore_v1 as snapshot.

noah: Thanks. Idempotency approach? consumer-side or server-side dedupe?

sylvia: Both. We add X-Idempotency-Key header and idempotency_key in payload. Playbook router will reject duplicates for 15m. Consumers should dedupe too. Example header: `X-Idempotency-Key: sha256(account_id|event_ts|run_id)`

maya: Canary split? want to see MRR delta per-owner before full rollout.

sylvia: Canary = account_id % 100 < 2 (2%). We'll emit canary_flag and compute mrr_exposure delta; gate if > 0.75% or churn_pred shift > 1.5% abs.

integrations-bot: scheduled: playbook-webhook maintenance soft-gate at 2026-04-02T05:00:00Z (non-critical).

noah: Who does post-run validation? small smoke script to compare owner counts + shared-seat diffs would be great.

sylvia: Maya will own counts; I'll own model metric diffs. I'll post sample diffs here after run. Ping if you want to QA. :thumbsup:
